newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank depressed by stock overhang.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank depressed by stock overhang.

text.p: Royal Bank of Scotland shares were 5.5 pence lower at 554 pence in early trading on Tuesday, following a 22.5 pence fall in the price on Monday.
Dealers blamed the fall on a stock overhang, with SBC Warburg holding around a million of the bank's shares on Monday at a time when buying appetite was low.
"There was a big line that Warburgs got left with. When people heard that, everyone marked the stock down," a source at one U.S. investment bank said.
He said the move was due to a technical position in the market rather than newspaper reports of a possible acquisition.
Traders said SBC Warburg had now unwound most of its position and the latest weakness was in line with a softer tone in the rest of the sector.
